how_to_texts_sample: Saturate a cotton ball or cotton pad with the Soy-Based Nail Polish Remover. Wipe all nails and allow the remover to absorb into the nail for at least 20-30 seconds. Wipe each nail until the polish is fully removed. Wash hands and nails thoroughly and dry well. Make sure the nail bed is dry and clean before applying polish.

how_to_texts_sample:
Apply one to two coats of Deep Nutrition twice a week to revive the nails. Make sure to let dry between coats. Nail Treatment applies as a sheer, light pink color and dries with a light, glossy finish.
Once dried and set on nails for a few hours, you may remove the treatment before applying nail polish or praying with nail polish remover. Deep Nutrition is not water-permeable. (If you are not praying, you may leave it on just like a nail polish!)
In 3-4 weeks, enjoy your healthy, revived nails!
